versions.changelog:
- Initial release of social-auto-publisher v1.0.0.
- Automates content creation, AI illustration, scheduled publishing, interaction monitoring, and data review across Xiaohongshu, Weibo, and Twitter.
- Supports one-click and batch publishing, trending topic detection, and auto-reply with multiple reply styles.
- Includes compliance guidelines and platform-specific operation guides.
- Provides a complete workflow from topic planning to performance review with recommended scheduling.
